title: 06b-B T1: extractCampaignBible core function + happy-path tests
description:
Objective:
Add the new core module that extracts a structured CampaignBibleInput by calling a ModelClient with a chronological list of SessionRecapRecord. Cover the happy path with two tests: (a) parses a valid fenced bible_json block into a CampaignBibleInput; (b) the user message rendered to the model contains each session id and recap text.

Files:
- Create: packages/core/src/memory/campaignBibleExtractor.ts
- Create: packages/core/test/campaignBibleExtractor.test.ts
- Modify: packages/core/src/index.ts (re-export extractCampaignBible and ExtractCampaignBibleInput)

Steps:
1. Create packages/core/test/campaignBibleExtractor.test.ts with the two happy-path tests (Design field).
2. Run: npx vitest run packages/core/test/campaignBibleExtractor.test.ts --reporter=verbose
   Expected: FAIL — extractCampaignBible not exported.
3. Create packages/core/src/memory/campaignBibleExtractor.ts (Design field).
4. Add re-exports to packages/core/src/index.ts, next to the existing composeArcSummary block:
     export { extractCampaignBible } from './memory/campaignBibleExtractor.js';
     export type { ExtractCampaignBibleInput } from './memory/campaignBibleExtractor.js';
5. Re-run the vitest command. Expected: 2 tests PASS.
6. Run: npm run typecheck. Expected: success.
7. Commit:
     git add packages/core/src/memory/campaignBibleExtractor.ts packages/core/test/campaignBibleExtractor.test.ts packages/core/src/index.ts
     git commit -m "Add extractCampaignBible core function with happy-path tests (loreweaver-5ze)"
acceptance_criteria:
1. packages/core/src/memory/campaignBibleExtractor.ts exists and exports extractCampaignBible plus ExtractCampaignBibleInput.
2. packages/core/src/index.ts re-exports both.
3. packages/core/test/campaignBibleExtractor.test.ts contains the two happy-path tests; both pass.
4. npm run typecheck succeeds.
5. The commit message references loreweaver-5ze.

comments.author: Joseph Bongaarts
